# DSH Skin Studio · Desktop
中文说明 · Download · Report an issue
Create, preview and share complete skins in **DeepSeek Harness for Windows**. This repository now ma
intains the desktop edition, succeeding the deprecated WebUI-only 0.6.0-alpha.1.
Tested with **DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2**. Other desktop versions and operating systems are not yet ver
ified. Historical WebUI releases remain available in the release archive.
## Install

1. Start DSH desktop once to initialize its desktop profile, then save your work and quit it.
2. Ins

tall Node.js 22 or newer if `node --version` is unavailable.
3. Download the desktop release's **Sou

rce code (zip)** or `.tgz` archive and extract it to a permanent folder.
4. Double-click `install-de

sktop.cmd`, or run `node scripts/install-desktop.mjs` from that folder.
5. Reopen DSH. Open **Accoun
t menu → Settings → General → Custom skins → Open skin studio**.
The source archive includes the prebuilt client and all preset media. No build step is needed to ins
tall a release. Keep the extracted folder: your desktop profile links to it. The installer backs up
the selected profile, installs this package using DSH's bundled pnpm, and enables it without alterin
g other plugins' settings.
For custom installations:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The global `dsh plugin --profile desktop add` command may reject desktop profiles because they are m
anaged by Electron; use the included installer.
The desktop edition is also available as `dsh-skin-studio@0.7.1` on npm. To download it, run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Save your work and quit DSH before running the installer. Keep the extracted `package` folder. To up
date an existing installation, run the installer from the new package and fully restart DSH. Choose
either GitHub or npm; disable an earlier local skin studio entry before switching distribution chann
els. Versions through `0.6.0-alpha.1` remain the historical WebUI edition.
## Complete skin editing
| Page | Features |

| Library | Create, duplicate, edit, activate, delete and restore DSH defaults |
| Basic editor | Li

ght/dark palettes, OKLCH generation, image/video wallpaper and WOFF2 fonts |
| GUI components | Toke

n groups/search, component picker, per-component media, opacity and blur |
| Visual assets | Five se

mantic image positions, original/custom previews and sidebar branding |
| Copy | Bilingual fixed cop

y, structured text targets and input hints |
| Import & export | Portable `.dshskin` v5 packages, re
source validation and conflict choices |
Seventeen complete presets are bundled: Bright Studio, High Contrast, Tidal Paper, thirteen Nijigasa
ki character skins and one group skin. Media is included locally. Edited presets survive updates.
Edits preview live. **Apply & save** persists and activates the draft; **Cancel preview** restores t
he previous skin. The editor reports contrast/readability concerns and protects unsaved changes. Pic
kers support mouse/keyboard, F2 mode switching and Esc return. Visual positions that do not exist in
the current view are reported and left unchanged.
## Storage and migration
Desktop data lives in the independent `dsh-desktop-skin-studio` IndexedDB namespace. A lightweight l
ocalStorage snapshot restores the active skin at startup. The original WebUI database is untouched;
use `.dshskin` files to move skins between editions.
Legacy desktop v1 data upgrades transactionally to v2 with original rows and snapshot retained in `m
igration-backups`. Unconvertible records remain preserved with visible warnings. Switching skins, re
storing defaults, cancelling preview and unloading release media, fonts, observers and object URLs.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Edit TypeScript/TSX/CSS Modules in `src/`, then run `npm run build`. The lazy `client.js` is generat
ed with tsdown. React comes from the host's platform table; the plugin does not import private Harne
ss Client packages or create a second renderer.
CI verifies Node.js 22/24 on Windows and Linux; desktop runtime support is Windows only. Optional in
stalled-host checks are `npm run check:install`, `npm run asar` and `npm run drift`. Override `DSKIN
_RESOURCES_DIR`, `DSKIN_DSH_ROOT`, `DSH_HOME` or `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` for nonstandard locations.
See runtime notes, verification history, v5 format and design documentation. Report your DSH version
, plugin version and reproduction steps with issues.
## License
Source is **AGPL-3.0-only**, continuing the original project. Legacy desktop integration retains its
MIT notice in `LICENSE.local-MIT`; bundled fflate is MIT. Character artwork and logos have separate
rights and attribution in THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md.
